features: 【⌨️ 79-Key Folding Keyboard】 Acer TabFold features a 79-key layout with a folding design, measuring 248 × 112 × 10 mm. Made from ABS + PU material, the keyboard has a net weight of 307 g and is available in Grey.
【📶 Bluetooth 5.0 Connectivity】 Equipped with Bluetooth 5.0 and 3 Bluetooth connection channels, Acer TabFold supports wireless transmission over a distance of 10 m for compatible devices.
【🔄 Multi-OS Compatibility】 Supports Windows 8.0 and above, Android 4.3 and above, and iOS 13.4 and above, providing compatibility across supported Windows, Android and iOS devices.

【🔋 180mAh Rechargeable Battery】 Features a built-in 180mAh rechargeable battery with approximately 80 hours of working time and more than 6 months of standby time. Charging is supported through a USB-C port, with an approximate charging time of 2 hours.

【⚡ 5 Million Key Life】 Designed with a rated key life of up to 5 million keystrokes, Acer TabFold combines its compact folding form with specified operating voltage of 3.2–4.2V and working current of approximately 2mA.
